tracking.enter_code_prompt: Enter your delivery code to check the current status of your package.
tracking.fetch_error: Unable to fetch delivery status. Please try again.
tracking.important_note_message: Please note that the delivery status is updated in real-time. However, the delivery times might be subject to external factors such as weather conditions, traffic, and unforeseen delays. For any urgent requests or inquiries, please contact our support team directly.
tracking.note_1: Ensure the recipient is available at the delivery address during the estimated delivery time.
tracking.note_2: If the delivery status shows as 'Out for Delivery,' it means the package is on its way and will be delivered soon.
tracking.note_3: If 'Delivery Attempt Failed' is displayed, a second attempt will be made within the next 48 hours. Please check your address details.
tracking.note_4: For more information, visit our FAQ page or contact customer support.
